analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the second consecutive session. RSI has slightly rebounded from oversold territory but remains low. MACD histogram shows improvement but is insufficient to confirm a trend reversal. ADX at 52.9 indicates an overheated trend nearing exhaustion. The 5-day high is lower than the 20-day high, continuing a weak pattern. Difficulty in securing stop-loss width relative to volatility.

· SMA100($0.08)/SMA200($0.08) 대비 큰 폭 하회, 중장기 추세 약세
· 52주 위치(4.2%) + 현 가격대 역사적 저점 부근
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 27.3 → 30.3 (과매도 구간 진입): 소폭 반등 시도, 여전히 과매도
· MACD 히스토그램 -0.0021 → -0.0001 (개선): 약세 전환 신호 가능성 있으나 확인 필요
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치(중단 $0.06): 중단 부근 횡보, 밴드폭 39.61% 넓음
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($0.05): 52주 저가 기반
· 스윙 저항선 ($0.07): SMA50, 피벗 R1 레벨
· 5일/20일 고가 패턴 (Lower High): 약세 지속, 5일 고가($0.06) < 20일 고가($0.08)
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 1.25 (급증): 움직임에 힘 실림, 신뢰도 상승
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간): RSI 과매도 탈출 시점 관망, ADX 과열 경계 구간 진입
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.06) above SMA5/20 ($0.06/$0.06), below SMA50 ($0.07)
· Significantly below SMA100 ($0.08)/SMA200 ($0.08), indicating weak medium-to-long term trend
· 52-week position (4.2%) + Current price range near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 27.3 → 30.3 (entering oversold territory): Attempting a slight rebound, still oversold
· MACD histogram -0.0021 → -0.0001 (improving): Potential for weak reversal signal, requires confirmation
· Bollinger Band current price position (middle band $0.06): Sideways near the middle band, band width 39.61% is wide
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.05): Based on 52-week low
· Swing resistance ($0.07): SMA50, Pivot R1 level
· 5-day/20-day high pattern (Lower High): Weakness persists, 5-day high ($0.06) < 20-day high ($0.08)
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio 1.25 (surge): Movement has momentum, increasing reliability
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Wait for RSI to exit oversold, ADX entering overheated territory
